name: CandyCodeWeb
description: The browser face of candy-code's server mode — Vite + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia, shipped pre-built through Composer.

name: CandyCodeshot
description: Code → SVG/PNG screenshot generator.

name: CandyCodetime
description: Privacy-first coding-time tracker.

name: CandyFiles
description: Dual-pane terminal file manager.

name: CandyFlappy
description: Flappy-Bird in your terminal.

name: CandyGifView
description: Terminal GIF viewer CLI on top of sugar-animation.

name: CandyGit
description: Terminal Git client — a TUI for staging, branching, log, diff, stash, worktrees and rebase.

name: CandyGitServer
description: Smart-HTTP clone, fetch, auth-gated push and LFS live; SSH ForceCommand dispatcher and git-daemon advertisement at class level.

name: CandyImage
description: File in, best-protocol image out: auto/sixel/kitty/iterm2/half/quarter/ascii/symbols formats, cell sizing, and --dump-detect.

name: CandyKv
description: Persistent key/value store — multiple databases, binary data, glob filtering.

name: CandyMail
description: Email sending — SMTP + Resend HTTP API transports, attachments

name: CandyMdview
description: Markdown CLI viewer + pager.

name: CandyMinesweeper
description: Minesweeper on the SugarCraft stack.

name: CandyScriptui
description: Interactive terminal widgets you can call from shell scripts — prompts, tables, spinners, and more.

name: CandySql
description: Terminal SQL client for SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL with Workbench-style admin panels.

name: CandySshLauncher
description: A launch menu of your SSH hosts — pick one and connect.

name: CandyStarter
description: Starter project for building your own SugarCraft apps — scaffold with composer create-project.

name: CandyTetris
description: Tetris on the SugarCraft stack.

name: CandyTop
description: Terminal system monitor — cpu, memory, disk, network, process, container, GPU, BMC and VM boxes with braille graphs, gradient meters, 43 themes (42 ported from btop plus candy-top's own pastel) and btop-compatible config.

name: CandyVcr
description: Record + replay sugar-core sessions — JSONL/YAML cassettes, byte + cell-grid assertions, .tape→GIF renderer, CLI.

name: SugarAnimation
description: ANSI/GIF animation toolkit — GIF decode, frame playback, .ansi art. CLI: candy-gifview.

name: SugarAnsiParser
description: ANSI escape-sequence parser and state machine (SGR, cursor, erase, DEC modes).

name: SugarAsync
description: Async building blocks for ReactPHP — cancellation tokens and sources, disposable subscription handles, timeout / deadline / retry / debounce / throttle / fan-in helpers, in-flight coalescing, loop-free blocking retry engines, and a TTL async cache. The measured dependents census (as of 2026-11) is sugar-forms, sugar-vterm, candy-sql, candy-mail, candy-git-server and candy-codetime.

name: SugarCellBuffer
description: Buffer (2-D cell grid) and Cell value objects — the shared foundation for terminal rendering across the SugarCraft ecosystem.

name: SugarCharts
description: Charts that render in the terminal — line, bar, sparkline, heatmap, scatter, OHLC candlesticks, and inline images via Sixel / Kitty / iTerm2 — with documented accessibility behavior.

name: SugarCli
description: Ready-made CLI presentation widgets — status line, banner, section, stage, help text, frame, logo, and themes for terminal apps.

name: SugarColorprofile
description: Terminal color profile detection and color degradation (TrueColor → ANSI256 → ANSI → ASCII).

name: SugarConstraints
description: A ratatui-style constraint solver behind a one-method LayoutSolver interface: GreedySolver handles every constraint type (the deprecated CassowarySolver delegates to it), plus DockLayout pane geometry.

name: SugarCraft Core
description: Model–Update–View TUI runtime for PHP. Model/Msg/Cmd/Program, cell-diff renderer, ReactPHP event loop.

name: SugarDashboard
description: Dashboard TUI library — column grid, constraint layout, ratio grid, data grid, tree, modal, status bar, tabs, plot/canvas, and a module/plugin system.

name: SugarDatepicker
description: Interactive month-grid date picker — keyboard navigation, min/max date constraints, localized day and month names (17 locales), ANSI rendering.

name: SugarDiff
description: One faithful diff -u engine for the whole ecosystem: LCS line diffing with budgeted fallback, numbered hunks, a GNU-shaped writer, and a patch scanner that tells any gutter which line each row points at.

name: SugarFlexbox
description: Flex-style cell layout, sortable/filterable tables with delta rendering, sticky viewports and scrollbars for terminal UIs.

name: SugarFocus
description: Focus-ring state machine for full-window TUIs: register each focusable region, map Tab to next() and Shift-Tab to previous(), and accent-border the region current() returns only where isEnabled() agrees. Immutable, dependency-free.

name: SugarForms
description: Form engine (port of charmbracelet/huh) plus the raw component implementations that sugar-widgets re-exports — Groups, themes, validators, fuzzy / async suggestions.

name: SugarFuzzy
description: Fuzzy string matcher that returns matched character indices plus the match score. Two algorithms: Smith-Waterman (local alignment) and Sahilm (gum-style). Enables filter-highlighting UIs impossible with score-only matchers.

name: SugarGallery
description: Browse-grid widgets for media TUIs: a 2-D virtualized PosterGrid that holds only the cards that have been fetched (sparse, absolute-indexed) and exposes a visible-range window for owner-pulled paging, a Rail carousel, and a renderer-agnostic PosterCard. Immutable.

name: SugarIgnore
description: One ignore engine for every tool that walks a repository: hand it the ignore files' contents, ask whether a path is ignored, and get the deciding rule back — safe against hostile patterns.

name: SugarImage
description: Image-to-cell renderer for the terminal — Sixel, Kitty, iTerm2, chafa CLI, or Unicode half/quarter block, ASCII ramp, and the chafa symbol engine.

name: SugarInput
description: EscapeDecoder consumes raw TTY bytes and emits typed Events. Supports legacy keys, Kitty keyboard protocol, xterm modifyOtherKeys, SGR 1006/1016, urxvt 1015 and X10 mouse, focus events, and bracketed paste, with typed terminal-reply draining. Native PHP — decoding semantics follow charmbracelet/bubbletea.

name: SugarLog
description: Colorful leveled logger.

name: SugarMarkdown
description: Markdown → ANSI renderer.

name: Sugar MCP Client
description: One faithful Model Context Protocol client core for the whole ecosystem: a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope codec, a newline-framed stdio transport with a bounded child lifecycle, the initialize/tools handshake, and deny-before-allow server narrowing — tool rosters follow servers.

name: SugarMetrics
description: Counters, gauges, histograms, UpDownCounters, AsyncCounters, AsyncGauges — five backends (InMemory, JsonStream, StatsD, Prometheus textfile, Multi fan-out), plus drop-in SSH session middleware for SugarSshServer.

name: SugarMouse
description: Mouse support for terminal UIs — tag rendered output with private-use zone markers (zero-width to the scanner; hosts may render PUA glyphs), then hit-test where clicks land.

name: SugarNavstack
description: Navigation breadcrumbs for terminal UIs.

name: SugarOverlay
description: Modal/overlay compositing for terminal UIs — foreground content over a background at any position with cell offsets, backdrop dimming, animated transitions, border chrome and click-zone hit-testing.

name: SugarPanels
description: H/V panels with flex/natural sizing, borders, nesting, and stateful delta rendering.

name: SugarPty
description: Pseudo-terminal primitives — spawn child processes wired to a controlled PTY, with resize forwarding and non-blocking I/O.

name: SugarQuickpick
description: Fuzzy finder / quick-pick overlay for terminal UIs.

name: SugarReadline
description: Interactive line-editing prompt state machines for terminal UIs — text, selection, confirmation, multi-selection and textarea.

name: SugarReleases
description: One fail-closed self-update engine for every phar-shipped SugarCraft app: pick the right release from a shared GitHub release stream, verify the bytes before the rename, keep a one-shot undo copy, and tell the user at launch when a newer release exists.

name: SugarSpring
description: Damped spring physics, projectile sim, easing/bezier timing and reduced-motion snapping for spring-driven types.

name: SugarSshServer
description: Run interactive terminal apps over SSH — composable middleware for serving your TUIs from OpenSSH.

name: SugarStyle
description: Declarative styling and layout for terminal output — colours, borders, tables, trees, and themes.

name: SugarTable
description: Customizable keyboard-driven data table with sorting, pagination, and a programmatic row cursor.

name: SugarTesting
description: ProgramSimulator drives a Program with scripted input; captures model/view/cmds. Assertions provides assertGoldenAnsi, assertCellGrid, assertAnsiEquals, assertViewIdempotent. TapeRecorder emits VHS .tape files.

name: SugarToast
description: Floating notification overlays.

name: SugarTreelist
description: List view with box-drawing prefixes, cursor navigation, word-wrap, and live filtering.

name: SugarVideo
description: Terminal video player — mp4/gif/webm/webp/avi → ascii/ansi256/truecolor/half- & quarter-block/sixel/kitty/iTerm2, with WebVTT subtitles.

name: SugarVterm
description: In-memory virtual terminal emulator. ANSI byte stream → cell grid + cursor + mode state.

name: SugarWidgets
description: A collection of ready-made TUI components — inputs, tables, spinners, progress bars, and more.

description: Default key bindings for every candy-* terminal app, with cross-references to each README.

description: What the SugarCraft terminal sanitizers defend, where the boundary sits, and what remains your duty.
